correctness.rationale: Exact character orthogonality on every finite abelian factor gives B_i 1=-1 and B_i*B_i=n_i I-J; mean-zero modes are independent singular blocks of √n_i. On normalized constant modes the full matrix equals the explicit real symmetric S, whose Schur complement is -diag(n_i), determinant (-1)^d∏n_i and inverse given by direct block multiplication. Combining determinant and singular-value products proves ∏n_i^(n_i/2) and exact invertibility for every d>=2 and n_i>=2; numerical direct character-table SVD and determinants pass for nine mixed cyclic/noncyclic configurations. Infinite/all-group statement rests on proof, not experiments.

value.rationale: Radius-one Hamming balls in arbitrary finite abelian products are canonical joint time–frequency sampling masks, including mixed-alphabet data channels. Their Fourier principal minors have previously non-apparent universal exact determinant, full singular spectrum and constructive inverse, yielding sharp stable reconstruction even with unequal nonisomorphic factors. The full-ball versus shell distinction changes singularity; exact heterogeneity is a natural invariant needed for precision interpolation and coding applications, not a gratuitous numerical slice. Known uniform-special-case claims do not give this mixed-product classification.
